title: WorkPulse document.deleted v1
description: A document was soft-deleted and its stored object purged. Identifiers and category only — the title, original filename, storage keys and presigned URLs are PII and never leave the database (`.ai/features/employee-documents.md` → Events; `.ai/security.md`). The Kafka message key is `employee_id` (ADR 0012).

employee_id.description: Employee the document belonged to (UUIDv7 string). Also the Kafka message key (ADR 0012).

category.description: Document category code. Never the title, filename or storage key.
